subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins surface reactions and other non-message activity through the existing runtime system-event/inbound APIs, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook or adapter contract?
rationale: Both approaches are plausible in current main, but choosing one affects the public Plugin SDK and overlaps with an open inbound_activity PR.

options.title: Document Current Runtime Path
options.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events or classified inbound events, document the required context and examples, and add code only if that recipe proves insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Event Hook
options.body: Define a typed Plugin SDK hook or adapter for non-message channel activity and align it with the related inbound_activity PR before merging implementation work.

options.title: Defer For Plugin Proof
options.body: Ask for a minimal Zoho Cliq plugin sketch showing why runtime.system.enqueueSystemEvent and runtime.channel.inbound.run cannot cover the use case.

recommendation.title: Document Current Runtime Path
recommendation.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events or classified inbound events, document the required context and examples, and add code only if that recipe proves insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history ties steipete to the central plugin SDK/channel runtime and docs surfaces where this public contract would be decided.
